'''Tenman Tenjingu''' (天満天神宮) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}} ({{ill|Tenmangū|en|Tenmangū|qid=Q798838|lt=Tenmangu|1=Tenmangū}}). There are 11 {{ill|Religious corporation|lt=Religious corporation|lt=Religious corporations|ja|宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious corporations|qq=}} with this name.

* {{ill|Tenman Tenjingu (Ichikawa City)|ja|天満天神宮 (市川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenman Tenjingu (Ichikawa City)|qq=}} - A shrine located at the site of the former Ōno Castle in Ōnocho, Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture, and is an outer shrine of {{ill|Honkōji|ja|本光寺 (市川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Honkōji|1=Honkō-ji Temple|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11519862}}. It is not a religious corporation.
